sources.title: sayksii/Aria: ARIA - AI Realtime Intelligent Audio - GitHub
sources.snippet: ARIA is a Windows desktop app for turning system audio into live subtitles. It can listen to audio from video players, browsers, games, and calls, then show the recognised text in a movable overlay. Translation can be shown in a separate overlay when needed.
